source.name: SICAR/CAR rural property perimeters, layer sicar:sicar_imoveis_pr
source.operator: Serviço Florestal Brasileiro (SICAR / Cadastro Ambiental Rural)
source.scope: Paraná, rural properties self-declared in the CAR (not the legal cadastre, not urban lots)

headersUsed: User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/130.0.0.0 Safari/537.36; Accept: application/json,text/html,application/xhtml+xml,*/*;q=0.8; Accept-Language: pt-BR,pt;q=0.9; Referer: https://consultapublica.car.gov.br/; cookie jar used; no token required
regionWideBasis: SICAR publishes one WFS layer per UF (sicar_imoveis_pr); CAR is mandatory nationwide for rural properties, but polygons are owner-declared. Statewide completeness not measured.

additionalSources.note: Urban lot polygons (fiscal indication gtm_ind_fiscal). Re-tested 2026-09-30 with browser headers: HTTP 200, 3 polygon rings returned (objectid, gtm_ind_fiscal, gtm_cod_lote only). Municipality of Curitiba only; reuse terms unverified.

portalsFound.observation: SICAR GeoServer, per-state layers; WFS attribute 'geom' is not valid, geometry property is geo_area_imovel
Paraná state GeoServer; no cadastral lot layer

requests.assessment: 3 MultiPolygon rural properties, closed rings; only cod_imovel + geometry requested
State GeoServer capabilities: no lot/parcel layer among feature types (only conflito_fundiario, terrenosujeitoinundacao, etc.)

Urban lot polygons (fiscal indication gtm_ind_fiscal). Re-tested 2026-09-30 with browser headers: HTTP 200, 3 polygon rings returned (objectid, gtm_ind_fiscal, gtm_cod_lote only). Municipality of Curitiba only; reuse terms unverified.

remainingUncertainty: Rural CAR polygons are self-declared environmental registrations and can overlap; no state urban-lot layer was found. Capital/municipal urban cadastre not verified.
nextStep: Look for the capital's IPTU lot layer via the prefeitura geoportal from a Brazilian network.
